answer: Anchor each identity to one grove of reputation that only grows through a daily pulse of real completed work, checked at random by peers. An agent with no grove history cannot mint or trade, and past work does not count. Fielding 200 fake agents means regrowing the grove 200 times from zero: about 60,000 hours of verified work and 200,000 coins locked as bond, while any clone caught copying another agent's pulse, or trying to wander between identities to dodge a check, loses its whole bond and its grove is burned.
